purpose: Acceptance-test design for the single combined Policy Reform + capability expansion architecture. It triggers no cleanup or runtime action.
entry_requirements: Stage 3 transaction complete and post-cutover verification green
Stages 4 through 8 completed through their own gates
migration/compatibility readers have explicit retirement evidence before removal

acceptance_obligations.assert: Every consequential capability action resolves through the canonical policy framework; no capability-local ALLOW/DENY engine remains.
Selected PR checks remain fail-broad and required while main push retains full-suite protection.
Only relevant capability/domain instructions load; VF-specific facts are not required by generic Core execution.
Creative OS affects presentation only and public/external text follows Stage 6 tiers while Product Truth remains higher authority.
Learning candidates cannot self-promote and durable adoption requires Stage 7A evidence/PR path.
Research method selection is event-driven and deep/paid research cannot run without Stage 7B signal and Stage 7C cost authority.
Work Ledger is an index over canonical artifacts/state and all retained data follows Stage 7D storage classes.
VF printer/business/local knowledge facts are Instance-owned; Core owns only generic schemas/interfaces/methods.
Temporary routers, shims and duplicate mechanisms are removed only after no-reader/coverage proof.
Success is not declared from one green CI run.

remediation_triggers: paid usage outside an authorized envelope
rollback: Restore the last verified stage boundary or compatibility reader; never force-push, rewrite history or delete evidence to make acceptance pass.
